title: 第1章 网游：天下
slug: 顶级奸商无敌从贩卖军火开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“林风，游戏头盔到了，快醒醒！”

林风缓缓睁开眼睛，看到的是弟弟林文兴奋的面容。

“你看，是《天下》的游戏头盔！”

面前赫然摆放着两个游戏头盔。

林文忍不住手舞足蹈：“没想到，我们只是随便提交问卷，竟然真的送我们两个头盔！”

“游戏刚刚开服，我听说一个头盔已经炒到8万块钱，我们拿去卖掉，就有钱给妈看病了！”

妈？看病？《天下》开服？

林风脸上带着震惊的表情：“我回到五年前了？”

“什么五年前？你是不是兴奋过头了，起床了，快，我们去卖头盔！我都联系好买家了！”

林风缓过神，猛的抓住林文：“不能卖！”

林文疑惑的看着林风：“不卖？！那做什么？”

“我们自己玩！”

“啊？你疯了？这可是8万块钱！没开玩笑？？”

林文看疯子似的看着林风。

林风摇了摇头，眼神中充满坚定：“相信我，不能卖，至少要留下一个！”

当年，两人卖了游戏头盔，付了母亲的住院费，可最终还是因为没钱手术，母亲离世。

林风却在母亲离世之后，进入游戏《天下》。

成为《天下》里的一名商人，赚了不少钱。

至少足够母亲手术，可母亲等不到了。

这是林风最后悔的事情。

只是后来，发生一些事，被人杀死。

既然重生回来，林风就不会让这样的事情发生。

林文盯着林风，甩开他的手，怒道：“疯了，我看你一定是疯了，你就那么想玩游戏吗？”

“这可是妈的住院费啊！”

如果不是带着记忆，林风也会以为自己疯了。

“这游戏头盔是我们改变命运的唯一办法，给我一个星期时间，我会弄到妈的手术费！相信我，让我试一试！”

一个星期后，正是母亲做手术最佳时候。

林文呆呆的看着林风：“一个星期？”

“你果然疯了！！那可是整整五十万！！还有后续治疗，你玩游戏能弄到？？”

林风的目光坚定：“相信我！让我试一试！”

他也没有十足的把握，但是，不试一下怎么知道。

林文激动的情绪也慢慢冷静下来。

两人从小一起长大，林风是什么样的人林文很清楚。

林文拿着游戏头盔咬牙说道：“你会后悔的！！！”

说完，便气冲冲的带着一个头盔离开。

林风则拿起另外一个头盔。

深吸一口气：“我不会后悔，更不会留下遗憾！”

双手捧着头盔，缓缓戴上，头盔中漆黑一片。

突然亮起光芒。

【扫描虹膜】

【虹膜扫描成功】

Page (1/3)

"Lin Feng, the gaming helmet has arrived, wake up!"

Lin Feng slowly opened his eyes and saw the excited face of his younger brother Lin Wen.

"Look, it's a gaming helmet from "Tianxia"!"

There were two gaming helmets placed in front of him.

Lin Wen couldn't help but dance with joy: "Unexpectedly, we just submitted the questionnaire casually, and they actually gave us two helmets!"

"The game has just launched. I heard that a helmet has been sold for 80,000 yuan. If we sell it, we can have money to treat my mother!"

Mom?see a doctor?"Tianxia" server launched?

Lin Feng had a shocked expression on his face: "Have I gone back to five years ago?"

"What five years ago? Are you too excited? Get up, hurry up, let's sell helmets! I've already contacted the buyer!"

Lin Feng calmed down and grabbed Lin Wen fiercely: "You can't sell it!"

Lin Wen looked at Lin Feng in confusion: "If you don't want to sell it?! What will you do?"

"Let's play by ourselves!"

"Ah? Are you crazy? This is 80,000 yuan! Are you kidding??"

Lin Wen looked at Lin Feng like a madman.

Lin Feng shook his head, his eyes full of determination: "Believe me, you can't sell it, at least one must be kept!"

At that time, the two sold gaming helmets to pay for their mother's hospital bills, but in the end, their mother passed away because they had no money for surgery.

However, after his mother passed away, Lin Feng entered the game "World".

Became a businessman in "The World" and made a lot of money.

At least it was enough for my mother’s surgery, but my mother couldn’t wait any longer.

This is what Lin Feng regrets the most.

But later, something happened and he was killed.

Now that he is reborn, Lin Feng will not let such a thing happen.

Lin Wen stared at Lin Feng, shook off his hand, and said angrily: "Crazy, I think you must be crazy, do you really want to play games?"

"This is the mother's hospitalization fee!"

If it weren't for the memory, Lin Feng would have thought he was crazy.

"This gaming helmet is the only way we can change our destiny. Give me a week and I will get the money for mom's surgery! Trust me, let me give it a try!"

A week later, it was the best time for my mother to undergo surgery.

Lin Wen looked at Lin Feng blankly: "One week?"

"You are really crazy!! That's half a million yuan!! And follow-up treatment, can you get it by playing games??"

Lin Feng's eyes were firm: "Believe me! Let me give it a try!"

He wasn't completely sure, but how would he know if he didn't try it.

Lin Wen's excitement gradually calmed down.

The two grew up together, and Lin Wen knew very well what kind of person Lin Feng was.

Lin Wen held the game helmet and gritted his teeth and said: "You will regret it!!!"

After saying that, he angrily left with a helmet.

Lin Feng picked up another helmet.

Take a deep breath: "I will not regret it, let alone leave any regrets!"

Holding the helmet in both hands, he slowly put it on, and the helmet was completely dark.

Suddenly there was a light.
